wallbox.title: Electric car
wallbox.description: Compares the electric car with a combustion car. What is charged at the wallbox is measured.

data_description.investment: Extra purchase cost over a combustion car. For the payback.

wallbox_values.title: Average since {since}
wallbox_values.description: For the time since {since}, Home Assistant knows neither fuel prices nor consumptions. Enter averages. They also apply from now on, until you change them.

data_description.ev_consumption: At the wallbox with charging losses, usually 10–15 % above the car's display. With several cars, their average.
data_description.combustion_consumption: What a comparable combustion car would have used
data_description.tariff: Only with a separate tariff for the car; otherwise the energy dashboard's price counts
data_description.fuel_price_entity: Replaces the average from now on

error.scop_range: Enter a seasonal COP between 1 and 10.

abort.no_energy_dashboard: First set up the grid import with an electricity price in the [energy dashboard](/config/energy). Then you can add Energy Payback.
abort.nothing_to_evaluate: The [energy dashboard](/config/energy) has neither solar production nor individual devices. Add at least one of them there.
abort.energy_interface: The energy dashboard cannot be read. This version of Home Assistant is not supported yet; please look for an update of Energy Payback.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Energy Payback is already set up. Add more on its integration page.

create_entry.default: The past is now being computed; this usually takes less than a minute. You find the card "Energy Payback" under "Add card" when editing a dashboard.

energy_interface.title: Energy Payback cannot read the energy dashboard
energy_interface.description: This version of Home Assistant stores the energy dashboard or its statistics in a way Energy Payback does not understand. The savings are unavailable until Energy Payback is updated.

no_grid_price.title: Energy Payback is missing the electricity price
no_grid_price.description: The energy dashboard has no grid import with an electricity price anymore. The savings keep their last values until it is set up again in the [energy dashboard](/config/energy).

missing_meter.title: {category}: meter missing in the energy dashboard
missing_meter.description: The energy dashboard no longer has: {meters}. {category} keeps its last figures until this is fixed. Add the meter back in the [energy dashboard](/config/energy), or choose other meters with Reconfigure on the integration page of Energy Payback.

missing_price_entity.title: {category}: price sensor missing
missing_price_entity.description: The price sensor {entity} no longer exists. Until it is replaced, its last value counts. Choose another one, or none, under Reconfigure › Values from now on on the integration page of Energy Payback.
